components.gap: Construction/argument and the full treatment promised by 'proved=annex:p15.bayes-normal-calculation' are not completely written for the stated joint observation density m_n(x_{1:n}). It rests on the square identity at annex ll. 313-319. The annex checks only the theta^2 and theta coefficients, which hold by the definitions of v and u. The one nontrivial part, equality of the theta-free constant terms mu_0^2/tau^2 + xbar^2/s^2 = u^2/v + (xbar-mu_0)^2/(tau^2+s^2), is asserted at ll. 322-324 ('the remaining constants agree after putting them over tau^2 s^2(tau^2+s^2)'). The computation is not shown, and the step is not instead derived from the cited normal-sum theorem. That makes it a sketched step under the audit rule. The posterior normal(u,v), the predictive laws, the covariance v and the numerical case are otherwise written at ll. 295-350.

defect_observations.observation: Square identity: only the theta^2 and theta coefficients are checked. The constant-term equality fixing m_n's factor phi_{tau^2+s^2}(xbar-mu_0) is asserted, not computed, and not derived from thm:p15-normal-sums either. This is the basis of the partial verdict.

The entry calls -log m_n the 'cumulative conditional logarithmic score' and never defines the term apart from this identity. The cited K-R sec. 3.2 (held text ll. 294-297, 355-368, p. 777) uses the opposite orientation: LS = sum_i log pr_i(y_i), log pr(D|H_k) = LS_k and log B_10 = LS_1 - LS_0. The inversion is undeclared. Not scored as a failure: in this queue 'source variants' denotes publication/version variants, and the K-R version is preserved. A one-sentence declaration would remove the ambiguity.

B_H is exactly the K-R sec. 3.1 Bayes factor (held text ll. 280-291). The chapter, which takes its source from K-R, never uses that name and calls it the 'update multiplier'. The terminology change is undeclared, unlike the declared 'distribution function' change in the finite chapter (F ll. 51-53).

Grinstead-Snell Def. 4.2 (book p. 141, PDF p. 149) also gives an equivalent complement-sequence form of mutual independence. The handbook gives only the subset form, and C011 proves complement independence for pairs only. Whether the scope notes identified this form as a required variant could not be checked, because spec/research is off-limits to this audit.
